title: jmap: wire Email/set (keywords) into route_method()
description: Why: Email/set handler exists in crates/mail/src/email/set.rs and UserFlagsStore is wired in SQLite, but Email/set is never called from route_method() in server.rs. Clients cannot mark articles as read ($seen) or flagged ($flagged) via JMAP — the core read-state feature. What: Add an Email/set arm to route_method() in server.rs that calls handle_email_set(). Keyword-only updates ($seen, $flagged) are already handled; destroy and mailboxIds changes are already rejected as notPermitted. No new logic needed — just wire the call.
